title: Explain endpoint sends cell values and member captions to the LLM vendor even under SAIKU_AI_LLM_EGRESS=schema-only

criteria.given: LLM egress is schema-only (cell data not permitted to leave the box) and a narrative is requested
criteria.then: CellExplainService does not call the LLM provider at all: the question carries the cell value and member captions, so the deterministic narrative is kept and a note says why

criteria.given: LLM egress permits aggregated cell data
criteria.then: the LLM narrative path is unchanged
it is the same AiAskService.permitsCellDataEgress() decision the ask path uses for the digest, current query and history, not a second copy

criteria.given: the regression tests for the fix
criteria.then: CellExplainServiceTest covers schema-only (no provider call, COMPUTED narrative) and an unwired egress guard failing closed
